import html # Example HTML template with placeholders for poster_name, headline, text and tags. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{headline}

Posted by: {poster_name}

{text}
{tags}
""" def compose_post_html(poster_name: str, headline: str, text: str, hashtags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- poster_name : str Name of the author. headline : str Post headline. text : str Main content of the post. hashtags : list[str] List of tags associated with the post. Returns ------- str A string containing a safe HTML representation of the post. """ # Escape all user‑supplied content to prevent XSS safe_poster_name = html.escape(poster_name, quote=True) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_text = html.escape(text, quote=False) # Preserve newlines as text # Build the tags string with each tag wrapped in a safe_tags = ''.join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in hashtags ) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( poster_name=safe_poster_name, headline=safe_headline, text=safe_text, tags=safe_tags )
